title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Payment Service Terms
content:
Payment service terms of Unemployment Benefit Claims are the same for all seven programs: Regular State Unemployment Insurance, Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE), Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX), Combined Wage Claim (CWC), Extended Benefits (EB), Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) and Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA).

| Term | Figure for every program |
|---|---|
| Wait after the check issue date before a paper check reported lost or stolen may be stopped and reissued | 10 business days |
| Method used to reissue a payment returned by the receiving bank | Paper check |
| Payment method change lead time (business days after the change is recorded before payments are issued through the new method) | 2 business days |
| Replacement debit cards issued without a fee per benefit year | 1 |
| Payment method assigned when the claimant makes no direct deposit election at filing | State benefit debit card |

Business days run Monday through Friday and exclude Lakeland state holidays.

### Points of reading

- A deposit returned by the bank is reissued by paper check whatever method the claim otherwise carries.
- A claimant who made no direct deposit election at filing is paid on the state benefit debit card.
- After the one fee-free replacement card in a benefit year, a further replacement is not fee-free.
